sub_accept: Walk to the edge of this one
Walk north to the Dry Rim, the edge of this one,

gv_the_seam_is_the_zone.accept_append: There is a seam running down north-east of my bench and another to the south-west. Either will do. Both is better.

gv_what_climbs_out.accept_append: It is the sunbleached stalkers. Kill them at the top of the road and take the tally sticks they carry.

gv_the_cutters_stock.accept_append: Shardback crawlers nest on the seams. You will have to clear them before you can cut.

gv_mv_open_the_door.accept_append: They are sodden diggers now. Put them down.

gv_mv_still_on_shift.accept_append: Vein crawlers have got in among them. Kill those as well.

gv_mv_glassmaw.accept_append: The crews named it Glassmaw. Kill it.

gv_ci_further_down.accept_append: Sanna says there are things on the way down that hum at the rock. She calls them seam singers. You will have to get past them.

gv_ci_the_choir.accept_append: I am calling it the Resonance. Find it and stop it.

gv_ci_standing_water.accept_append: There are cistern lurkers in that water. Kill them, and look at what they were keeping you from.
